lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏥᏳᎯ ᎤᎾᏣᎢ ᎤᏂᎷᏨ ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᏂᎯ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏥ.
lines.english: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏚᏂᏐᏨ ᎨᏂᏏᎳᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ.
lines.english: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᎿᎭᏃ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᎬᏬᎵᏨ, ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏏᏙᎸᎩ, ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏧᏂᏢᎩ.
lines.english: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩᏃ ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛᏉ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᏄᏩᎥ ᎤᎾᏒᏁᏗᏱ, ᏂᎦᏛᏃ ᎤᎾᏒᏂᎸᎯ ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏒᎩ.
lines.english: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
